thread:
mira: opened a docs PR for the metering + pricing examples. main changes: clarifies per-tier billing math, adds a compact Grafana panel, and swaps old metric names. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4620

alex: quick scan 1: the metric rename from `rate.total` -> `rate_requests_total` is in prod now. we should show both in the note but prefer the new name in code samples. also the label for tiers is `plan_id` not `plan` in ingestion.

sam: yep ingestion uses `plan_id`. the burst metric is `burst_credits_consumed_total`. recommend we show query examples with regex label matcher: `rate_requests_total{plan_id=~"pro|startup|free"}` so readers can copy/paste.

ravi: on the billing math: we need to show rounding to billing units. suggested pseudocode in docs: "units = ceil(tokens / 1000); cost = units * unit_price[plan_id] + burst_used * burst_price". also add an example where tokens < 1000 but still billed as 1 unit.

mira: added the ceil example and an explicit table for unit_price per plan. also included a short migration note that old aliases will be accepted for 180 days and to contact support for exceptions.

alex: the SDK snippets: earlier PR used camelCase `groupBy`. our public SDK surface is snake_case `group_by` for list_usage. change that and include Node + Python. keep Go out for now.

sam: flagged the Grafana transform 1: current panel JSON summed across `region` which duplicates counts. changed the transform to "Group by -> plan_id" and updated the panel file. pushed a new panel json to infra repo at `dashboards/metering/compact-panel-2026.json`. link: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/metering/compact-panel-2026.json

mira: awesome. can someone sanity-check the rendered pricing table in the preview? docs-ci-bot link?

docs-ci-bot: preview build ready 1: https://deploy.preview.redwood/4620 (build bd34ef). please check Pricing math, SDK examples, and the panel iframe. :white_check_mark:

ravi: reviewed preview. two tiny nits: 1) the Python snippet uses `client.get_usage(start, end, group_by=['plan_id'])` but our Python SDK uses kwargs `group_by` as a list of strings - correct. 2) the Node example forgot `await` on `client.list_usage(...)`. pushed a minor fix to the snippet branch.

alex: also, consider adding a small example for burst credit decay: "unused burst credits expire after 30 days from issuance" 1: ops asked to make that explicit in billing.md.

mira: added sentence to billing.md and referenced it in the pricing doc. final checklist: 1) update metric names in queries (alex), 2) update panel JSON link (sam), 3) add ceil billing snippet and example (ravi), 4) SDK snippet fixes (alex + ravi). I'll merge after CI passes and one more review.

sam: panel link is final. pushed commit to infra.

alex: updated queries + SDK naming.

docs-ci-bot: CI green 1: all checks passed. merge allowed.

mira: merged and closing thread. if there are any post-merge issues create a follow-up PR. thanks everyone!
